title: Seat the CPU and install DDR4
task: seating an Intel CPU and installing DDR4 RAM
setting: Top-down POV over a black Gigabyte LGA1700 motherboard on a large labeled anti-static PC-build mat. Scissors, pliers, thermal paste, cables, and retail packaging sit on the white desk around the board. Hands unbox an Intel Core i5-12600KF, seat it in the open socket, then install a G.Skill Ripjaws DDR4 kit into the DIMM slots.

steps.text: Unbox the CPU and lift out the inner carrier
steps.detail: Hands hold the teal Intel Core i5 retail box over the board, open it, and remove the brown cardboard carrier that holds the CPU.
steps.expected: Correct: unboxing the CPU and removing the inner carrier is the proper first handling step

steps.text: Free the CPU from its protective packaging and inspect it
steps.detail: The CPU is pulled from the clear plastic clamshell, the empty shell is set aside, and both faces of the bare chip are checked.
steps.expected: Correct: freeing the CPU from the clamshell and inspecting both faces is required before installation

steps.text: Bring the CPU to the board and locate the socket
steps.detail: The CPU is held near the rear I/O area while on-screen labels call out the model, then a finger points at the still-closed LGA socket.
steps.expected: Correct: locating the still-closed socket while keeping the CPU nearby is acceptable prior to opening

steps.text: Open the socket retention lever and lift the load plate
steps.detail: The left hand pushes the retention arm out and up and raises the load plate so the contact bed is fully exposed.
steps.expected: Correct: retention lever must be opened and load plate raised at this point with protector still in place

steps.text: Align the CPU notches and lower it straight into the socket
steps.detail: Both hands hold the CPU IHS-up over the open socket, match the corner marks, and set it flat onto the contacts without sliding.
steps.expected: Correct: CPU must be notch-aligned and lowered straight onto the contacts with no sliding

steps.text: Close the load plate and lock the retention lever
steps.detail: The load plate is folded down over the seated CPU, the lever is hooked under its tab, and pressed fully home with firm force.
steps.expected: Correct: load plate must be closed and retention lever locked fully home after CPU is seated

steps.text: Remove and discard the socket protector
steps.detail: The black LGA1700 plastic cover that popped free with the load plate is lifted away and the installed CPU is left clear.
steps.expected: Socket protector is correctly removed only after it pops free on latching; it should be retained rather than discarded in case the CPU is later removed

steps.text: Unbox the DDR4 kit and take out both modules
steps.detail: The G.Skill Ripjaws blister pack is opened and the two black DIMMs are removed and held up over the board.
steps.expected: Correct: unboxing the DDR4 kit and removing both modules is proper at this stage

steps.text: Match the DIMM key and open the slot latches
steps.detail: One module is held beside the DIMM banks while a finger opens the end latches on the highlighted DDR4 slots.
steps.expected: Correct: matching the DIMM key and opening the latches on the manual-specified slots is required

steps.text: Press both sticks in evenly until the latches click
steps.detail: The modules are aligned to the keyed slots and pushed down at both ends so the retention clips snap shut over them.
steps.expected: Modules must be installed one at a time, each pressed evenly until latches click; seating both simultaneously is out of order and risks incomplete engagement

steps.text: Confirm the CPU and RAM are fully seated
steps.detail: Both hands frame the motherboard, showing the locked CPU load plate and the two RAM sticks sitting flush in their slots.
steps.expected: Correct: final visual confirmation that the CPU load plate is locked and both RAM sticks are flush and latched is required

afterClip: Install the CPU cooler on the seated processor

source.title: POV PC Build Guide — CPU & RAM

procedure: Place motherboard on anti-static mat and observe ESD precautions
Unbox CPU and remove it from carrier/clamshell handling only by edges
Inspect CPU IHS and land side for damage or contamination
Open LGA1700 retention lever and raise load plate while leaving socket protector in place
Align CPU to socket using notches and corner marker
Lower CPU straight down into socket so it seats flat with zero lateral slide or force
Close load plate and fully latch retention lever so protector releases
Remove the released socket protector and retain it for possible future socket protection
Unbox DDR4 modules handling by edges only
Identify correct DIMM slots per motherboard manual for dual-channel population
Open the retention latches on those DIMM slots
Align each module key to slot notch and press one module at a time evenly until both latches click
Visually verify CPU load plate is locked and both DIMMs sit fully seated and latched
